errors.text: The initial HfMoTaTiZr alloy is incorrectly described as having a continuous ordered B2 matrix and less than 5% ductility; the target baseline is a single-phase BCC alloy with approximately 11.6% room-temperature compressive fracture strain.

The proposed B2 phase-inversion route is transferred from an Al-containing RHEA without evidence that the Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr chemistry has the required BCC/B2 phase field or can precipitate nanoscale B2 during aging.
The intervention omits the defining addition of 4.2 at.% Cr and the resulting approximately 4 vol.% reticulated multicomponent Laves phase.
No precise Hf/Ta-to-Ti/Zr composition is specified, so the claimed 10–15% density reduction, phase stability, and mechanical-property predictions are not quantitatively testable.
Twinning/TRIP is proposed from FCC HEA and MEA analogies without system-specific evidence for these mechanisms in the BCC Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr alloy.
